headline: ASEAN and China fail to finalize South China Sea code of conduct
summary: Negotiations between ASEAN and China failed to conclude a long-delayed South China Sea code of conduct despite reaching provisional agreement on 80% of the text during the Philippines' chairmanship.
why: The South China Sea is one of the world's busiest maritime trade corridors, carrying trillions of dollars in commercial freight annually.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Lack of agreement prolongs geopolitical uncertainty along critical Asian shipping channels.
